message: The other day, while I was rummaging through old boxes, I stumbled upon our family go-bags from a few years back. It sparked a lively group chat where everyone chimed in about what we needed to update—like adding extra snacks and making sure our important documents were in order. 📱 It was a fun reminder that being prepared can also bring us together, even when we're apart. Have you checked your family's emergency plans lately?
